---
title: "Coding habits: RSE vs non-RSE self-identification (GitHub ID)"
question_id: proj6uk_0
---

```{r}
#| include: false
#| file: ../R/_load_common.R
```

::: {.callout-note}
Raw answers to this question include personal identifiers (e.g. GitHub usernames).
This chapter reports only how many respondents provided an identifier, not the values themselves.
:::

```{r}
#| echo: false
question_code <- "proj6uk_0"
audience <- "United Kingdom"

df <- load_filtered_tf(audience)
answered <- !is.na(df[[question_code]]) & nzchar(as.character(df[[question_code]]))
n_answered <- sum(answered)
n_total <- nrow(df)

gt::gt(
  tibble::tibble(
    Country = audience,
    `Respondents` = n_total,
    `Provided identifier` = n_answered,
    `Percent` = if (n_total > 0) round(100 * n_answered / n_total, 1) else NA_real_
  )
) |>
  gt::tab_header(title = "GitHub identifier provided")
```
